view: Quiet wide landscape low rounded grass burial mounds at Birka Bjorko island, scattered birch trees, Lake Malaren behind, natural low earthworks not giant tumuli, no reconstructed Viking houses or ships.

eras.title: Mounds above the water
eras.caption: Birka's burial mounds and settlement remains lie on an island in Lake Mälaren. Excavation connects this quiet shoreline with the workshops, trade and long-distance contacts of a Viking-age town.
eras.prompt: Quiet wide landscape low rounded grass burial mounds at Birka Bjorko island, scattered birch trees, Lake Malaren behind, natural low earthworks not giant tumuli, no reconstructed Viking houses or ships.

evidence.basis: Archaeological remains and finds from the cited site reference. The era spans rediscovery onward; the scene is an interpretive study of exposed remains, not a dated first-discovery reconstruction.
